[[File:CutupFivesBunks-CC.png|thumb|right|250px|Clone cadets [[Fives/Legends|Fives]] and [[Cutup/Legends|Cutup]] in their bunks on [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]]]]
A '''bunk''' is a term that describes a [[Sleep/Legends|sleeping]] place, or a bed, that is usually found on a [[Starship/Legends|starship]]. A crew member may sleep there or keep personal belongings nearby during a voyage across the [[Galaxy/Legends|galaxy]]. They were able to be customized to a specific shape, for say, a [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]]. The [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']] had at least one on board, which [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] used after his [[Duel on Cloud City/Legends|duel]] on [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]] with [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]].
